reason: My whiteboard and my notebook have run that night for years and nobody has ever asked me for a screen. This sells me tidier admin, not more people through the door, and the one screen I have is showing the cricket, which is why half of them sit here in the first place.
objection: Nothing here tells me a single extra person walks in. My regulars are the same forty faces; a bracket on a TV does not make a forty-first, and if I put the bracket up I take the match off, so I may even lose a few.
would_change_my_mind: A venue my size, in a city like mine, showing me its counter takings for the competition night before and after - if the night actually got bigger, I would put it up next Tuesday.
